simple.meaning: עָפַר (ʻâphar) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to be dust.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in 2 Samuel, beginning at 2 Samuel 16:13. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עָפַר (H6080) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: עָפַר (ʻâphar) / H6080 is traced through 2 Samuel 16:13 with source-language evidence and verse context.
